name: Henry Schein
description: Henry Schein is the supply house for small health practices: it sells dental and medical consumables and equipment (and the technicians to install it) to dentists, physicians and clinics, about 85 percent of its $13.2 billion of FY2025 net sales. It is also, less visibly, a manufacturer of dental implants, biomaterials and endodontic and orthodontic products (Global Specialty Products, 11.7 percent of sales but 22 percent of segment profit) and a software vendor (Dentrix and other practice management software, 5.1 percent of sales but 16 percent of segment profit at about a 27 percent margin). Distribution earns about a 6 percent segment operating margin; the smaller segments pull the profit mix well above the sales mix. KKR-affiliated funds invested $250 million in the company in January 2025.

businessLines.description: Distribution of national-brand and Henry Schein corporate-brand dental and medical merchandise, dental equipment and equipment technical services, plus value-added services (practice financing, consulting).
